Candidate inner U minus R contains successful plain derivation preferring a later finite verb over an earlier one, open-class class() retaining a lexical lemma, and scan_store invoking the annotator. Class exclusion tested; root/call-graph exclusions source-inspected.

obernants.assumptions: Aligned nonempty sentence vectors and in-range heads are admission assumptions. Plain derive picks first finite VERB, else first VERB, else first NOUN/PROPN/ADJ, else index zero, and checks cycles. Empty derive/derive_easy inputs panic. The final plain cycle repair does not regenerate explanation steps. Helper evidence is not a proof of all file behavior.

obernants.operator: score/agree count labeled hits only for correct heads and divide by max(words,1); empty aggregate gives zero. scan reports parser-head agreement, not held-out gold accuracy.
